sanskrit_verse:
arakṣyamāṇāḥ kurvanti yatkiṃcit kilbiṣaṃ prajāḥ /
tasmāt tu nṛpater ardhaṃ yasmād gṛhṇāty asau karān //
transliteration: arakṣyamāṇāḥ kurvanti yatkiṃcit kilbiṣaṃ prajāḥ / tasmāt tu nṛpater ardhaṃ yasmād gṛhṇāty asau karān //
sph_interpretive_translation: When subjects commit any transgression due to lack of protection, the ruler assumes half the consequence, for he receives tribute from their hands.
jurisprudential_principles: Restoration logic requires proportional assumption of consequence
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of interdependence
executable_legal_axioms: IF Subjects commit transgressions AND Protection was insufficient THEN Ruler assumes 50% causal load
IF Tribute is received THEN Structural duty of safeguarding is binding
IF Governance capacity exists THEN Responsibility for societal order is non-delegable
IF Negligence in enforcement occurs THEN Restitution must align with receipt of societal yield
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when public harm arises from inadequate governance structures, the executive bears a quantifiable share of karmic and legal consequence proportional to revenue and control received from the populace.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that receipt of tribute constitutes evidence of reciprocal duty; anupūrvaśaḥ shows that failure to protect manifests subsequent disorder; thus, responsibility flows causally without punitive intent but purely for completion and correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign accountability review upon systemic failure
Reallocate administrative oversight based on demonstrated capacity
Implement dharmic correction via ritualized acknowledgment of duty breach
Restore subject confidence through visible recommitment to protective function
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: rulers are co-bearers of consequence where protection fails, not for punishment, but for restoration of dharma and realignment of consciousness.
